videos.desc: In a crowded street market in an Asian city in late afternoon light, a young woman with long blonde hair, a loose white shirt, beige trousers and sandals stands with a wheeled suitcase and an open guidebook. She looks up and around at the signs in a foreign script, then down at her book and around again as a motor scooter passes behind her. A stallholder hands a paper bag across a food cart, and paper lanterns, cycle rickshaws and tangled overhead cables fill the busy street.

At a small island harbour on a grey, windy day, a young woman with a long brown plait, a red jacket, jeans and boots stands on the wet stone quay next to a ferry's lowered ramp, a ticket in her hand. She sets down a cardboard parcel tied with string next to her backpack with a rolled mat, looks around and then calls out and points. Behind her a man pushes a trolley of sacks, and locals with a dog stand by a white cottage and orange floats.

On a working boat moored in a grey harbour, a young woman in a knitted hat, work gloves and navy overalls with an orange high-visibility jacket pulls hard on a rope with a squinting face, sounding a huge brass horn fixed to the white cabin, which shoots out a loud burst of steam. Then she lets go and shouts up at the horn. Behind her crew members in orange and navy workwear stand on deck, and a big flock of seagulls flies up from the quay.

A small white propeller plane stands on a tropical airstrip by a turquoise sea, with palm trees and a windsock. A laughing young woman with long wavy hair, a white shirt, a yellow flowered skirt and a denim jacket tied round her waist climbs the short metal steps to the open door, carrying a surfboard. A smiling pilot in a navy uniform leans out and helps her, and she steps up into the plane. Below, a ground worker in a yellow vest and ear protectors loads bags onto a luggage cart.

In a small harbour at sunset under dramatic clouds, a large three-masted sailing ship with grey sails comes into port past a stone lighthouse at the end of the pier, as waves splash high over the harbour wall. On the pier a man in a dark jacket swings a coiled rope towards the ship, and a crowd in yellow and orange oilskins cheers with raised arms. A bearded man in a dark jacket comes forward on the pier, smiling, and hauls in a coil of rope. Colourful houses and fishing boats line the harbour.

On a calm lake at sunrise with pine forest and mountains behind, a big red, orange and cream striped hot-air balloon with a wicker basket and a pilot is sinking slowly over the water, its reflection shining in the lake. In the foreground a young woman with red hair, sunglasses on her head, a white shirt and khaki trousers leans out of another wicker basket standing on the grassy bank and dips her fingers into the water, making ripples, then straightens up and smiles.

In a bare mountain valley at sunset, an orange off-road truck drives slowly through a wide, shallow glacial river with water splashing around its wheels, and the driver leans out of the window. Beside it a line of young hikers with backpacks hold hands and wade across, the water up to their knees. Behind them a gravel track leads to a yellow tent, with a glacier, dark mountains and steam rising in the golden evening light. Coloured marker poles stand on the near bank.

A laughing young woman in a white T-shirt, black trousers and striped socks leaps high through the metal detector arch at an airport security checkpoint with big windows onto parked planes. She lands, bows, and walks to the conveyor belt, where grey plastic trays hold her ankle boots, a brown belt, a denim jacket, a clear bag of toiletries and a whole pineapple, and she picks up her boots. A laughing security officer in a navy uniform holds a clipboard, and travellers in the queue laugh behind.

At night outside an airport arrivals building in falling snow, a young man in a denim jacket and patterned shirt, with a backpack, looks up in wonder at the snowflakes, a big brown suitcase and a cardboard box tied with string at his feet. A young woman in a bobble hat and dark parka wraps a thick hooded winter coat with a fur collar around his shoulders. He pulls it closed, laughs and keeps staring up at the snow. Other travellers pull suitcases past waiting taxis, and city towers glow behind.

An old stone inn with a snowy roof stands in a mountain village at dusk. A young woman with long red hair, in a cream winter coat, bobble hat and scarf, pulls a suitcase through deep snow towards the arched wooden door, where a man in a dark jacket waits in the warm light. A big brown and white St Bernard dog carries a lit lantern in its mouth and walks ahead of her up to the door. The man reaches up beside the door and smiles. Skis lean against the wall under a blank hanging wooden sign, and logs are stacked by the house.

An empty railway platform at night under a street lamp and a large clock. A young man in an olive parka, grey hoodie, jeans and a knitted beanie reaches up and places one more paper cup on top of a very tall, wobbly tower of cups stacked on his silver suitcase. He steps back, spreads his arms wide and then clenches his fists in triumph. Around him lie a long paper chain on a bench, a pile of folded paper boats and a few sandwiches. People doze on a bench behind him and a cat sits by the tracks.

A lakeside campsite at dusk, with dark pine forest and blue mountains behind the still water. A young woman in a cream knitted jumper, olive trousers and a head torch crouches by a ring of stones and carefully lays thin sticks upright in a cone over birch bark to build a campfire. She then sits back, takes a match from between her lips and holds it up with a smile. A chopping block with an axe and a pile of split logs stand beside her, a kettle and a frying pan sit on the stones, and a lantern glows by a canvas tent.

In a classic Parisian café with marble tables, bentwood chairs and a chalkboard menu, a young waiter in a white shirt, black waistcoat and bow tie politely helps a woman with long auburn hair take off her camel coat at the door. She wears a dark outfit and a patterned silk scarf and carries a straw basket with a leek sticking out. The waiter walks away holding the coat while she walks into the café and reaches for a chair at a table. Other waiters move past the bar.

In a marina at sunrise, with rows of white motor yachts and sailing boats with tall masts moored along wooden jetties, a muscular man in sunglasses and a white bathrobe kneels on a big pink inflatable flamingo, paddling with a wooden oar and balancing a tray of coffee cups and pastries. A small dog watches from the jetty, a couple in bathrobes stand on the jetty and an older man leans from the bow of a boat. Ripples spread on the calm golden water.

A small mountain railway station in falling snow at dusk. A young woman in a blue ski suit, a padded vest, a knitted hat and ski boots runs through the snow along the platform with skis and a pole in her arms, reaching out towards a red and cream train that keeps moving beside her. A conductor in a cap leans out of the open door and stretches out his hand, friends in ski gear wave from a window, and a porter with a luggage trolley stands by the lit wooden station hut.

A wooden treehouse in a rainforest during a rain shower. A young woman in a tank top, shorts and hiking boots stands on the small porch by the open door and pulls up a net bundle on a rope holding a cardboard box, a rolled sleeping mat, a potted plant and a bag, then lifts it onto the porch and turns towards the door. A monkey sits on the corrugated metal roof next to a lantern. A man on a platform below holds the other end of the rope, and huge tropical leaves surround the cabin.

A snowy reindeer corral at pink winter dawn. A young woman with long fair braids, a dark blue knitted hat with a red patterned band, a black snowsuit and fur-trimmed boots strides through the snow and pulls a large reindeer along by a rope lasso. Many more reindeer with big antlers crowd behind her inside a wooden fence. Behind them stand a cone-shaped canvas tent with a fire glowing inside, a snowmobile, a person in orange and a line of bare birch trees.

A sunny beach road. A young man in sunglasses, a linen shirt and shorts leans with one leg stretched out and pushes hard with both hands to slide shut the door of a pale blue vintage van crammed full with things and a pink inflatable flamingo. Surfboards, bags and folding chairs are piled high on the roof rack. The door closes and he stands up. On the sand three friends cheer with their arms up, one sitting on a cooler, and a beach ball, frisbee and towel lie on the road.

On a grass airstrip in a mountain valley in bright afternoon light, with snowy peaks and a glacier behind, a small cream and dark red single-engine plane with its propeller spinning comes in low and touches down on the grass. Its big fat wheels hit the ground and throw up bits of grass as it rolls past a windsock on a pole standing in an old tyre. The pilot sits in the cockpit, and a flock of sheep grazes in the field behind the plane.

In warm morning light, a man in a round helmet with goggles, sunglasses and a brown leather jacket rides a motorbike with a sidecar away from a stone cottage down a gravel lane. He looks back and smiles, then waves a gloved hand as dust sprays from the back wheel. A rolled green sleeping bag with a map is strapped behind him, and a shaggy grey-and-white dog sits in the sidecar. At the garden gate an older woman, young women and a man wave goodbye and cheer.

A jammed baggage belt in an airport arrivals hall. The view starts close on a big black suitcase and pulls back: suitcases and bags are piled high and stuck on the carousel, with a yellow suitcase on top of the pile. A young man in a cream jacket pulls hard at the black suitcase, a young woman in a camel coat holding a red suitcase watches beside him, and a worker in an orange high-visibility vest sorts the pile. Other travellers wait with trolleys by the big windows.

A cosy farmhouse kitchen with a black range cooker, copper pots and a dresser full of blue and white plates. A young man in a winter jacket and yellow scarf, his suitcase beside him, sits at a long pine table with a young woman in a lilac hoodie. A young woman with a red braid serves him a tall stack of pancakes and he starts to cut them, while a young man pours tea from a brown teapot. A cat jumps down from the dresser, a jug of orange juice stands on the table and snow lies outside.

Steep whitewashed steps in a sunny island village with blue doors, pink flowers and blue domes. A young man in a white shirt and beige shorts staggers under a huge pile of backpacks, duffel bags and a guitar case, an olive bag hanging at his side and a blue cool box in his hand. The pile wobbles and nearly slips as he struggles to hold it, his face strained. Up the steps his friends walk away from him, one carrying a crate of lemons, a woman sweeps by a door and a cat lies on a step.

Dusk outside a stone and wooden mountain hut high among snowy peaks. A young woman in a yellow jacket and snowshoes kneels in the deep snow, then jumps up with her arms thrown in the air, laughing as snow flies around her. A young man in a green jacket and knit hat, also on snowshoes, pushes open the hut's heavy wooden door, and warm light shines out from inside. A husky dog stands by the door, and prayer flags hang across the blue evening sky.

The open door of a bright whitewashed hotel room with a sea view and a balcony. Before anything else, a young woman in a white shirt and yellow shorts dives headfirst through the air onto the big white bed, her arms spread and her straw hat flying off, then lies stretched out on the bed with the hat beside her. In the doorway a young man in a blue shirt stands with the suitcases, smiling and laughing. Pink flowers stand by the bed and patterned tiles cover the floor.

A big striped hot-air balloon in orange, cream and blue on a grassy field at sunrise. A young woman in a blue jacket stands smiling in the wicker basket as it lifts slowly and smoothly off the ground and rises a little higher. Two people in warm jackets hold ropes and let them out bit by bit, while a black-and-white border collie jumps up at the basket and then runs about on the grass below it. More people and a pickup truck are in the background under a soft pink sky.

A selfie at a lakeside campsite on a sunny autumn day. A smiling young woman in a mustard beanie, a red puffer vest and a cream fleece holds the camera. Behind her an orange pop-up tent flies through the air, lands and stands fully open in a second. A young man in a green sweater cheers with both fists up, a young man in a navy sweater holding a pile of tangled green tent poles stares with his mouth open, and a spotted dog runs around the tent. Leaves fall, and a misty lake and a wooden jetty lie behind them.

A grand railway station with a green iron and glass roof and hanging globe lamps. A young woman in a long rust-coloured coat, dark jumper and skirt runs along the platform dragging a suitcase and reaches out towards a train that is pulling away beside her. The train leaves and the track is empty; she stops, turns towards the viewer and stares in shock with her mouth open. Behind her clothes lie spilled on the floor and a station worker in a navy uniform lowers his hand and stands watching.

The top of an old stone tower at sunset. A smiling young man in a white linen shirt leans on the lichen-covered wall, looks out, points at the view and laughs, and a second person's arms rest on the wall in the foreground. Below them spreads a wide view: red-tiled rooftops, a green river crossed by old stone arched bridges, rows of vineyards and olive trees, tall cypresses, and blue hills under pink and golden clouds.

A sandy beach on a clear sunny morning. Two workers in olive shirts unstack white sun loungers from a tall pile, and closed umbrellas stand in a row by a lifeguard tower. A young woman in a white shirt and orange swimsuit dives through the air onto a lounger, kicking up sand, lands on it and throws one arm up in triumph. A shirtless young man runs up and puts a blue cool box on the lounger next to her, and behind them a group of young people runs across the beach with towels.

A grand hotel lobby with a black and white chequered marble floor, gold columns and a starburst chandelier. At first a golden retriever in a maroon uniform vest is seen up close, its front paws on the marble reception desk next to a set of keys, and a hand picks up the keys. Then the whole lobby shows: the dog stands on its hind legs at the desk, a laughing young woman in a cream suit points at it, and a young man in a navy shirt lifts a suitcase near a brass luggage trolley. Guests sit behind them.

Seen through the eyes of a person standing on gravel, both hands raised, a navy duffel bag flies through the air and is caught. A laughing young man with curly hair and an open white shirt kneels on the roof of a white camper van and has just tossed it down. On the left a young woman carries a rolled sleeping bag into a pale green roadside motel room, and another young woman crouches by a cool box at the van. A pink neon star glows on a pole against an orange desert sunset.

A sunny bedroom where a young woman in a white vest and denim shorts kneels on top of an overfull silver suitcase, pressing the lid down with her weight. A young man in an orange T-shirt and yellow socks crouches in front of it and pulls hard at the zip, then falls backwards onto the floor, and both of them burst out laughing. A striped shirt and a yellow sock hang out of the gap. Clothes are piled on the bed, a white cat watches and a white curtain blows in at the window.

A young woman in a dark beanie, a muddy jacket and rubber boots stands on a grassy riverbank at dusk and lifts a heavy sandbag onto a wall of sandbags, where water is spilling through. Behind her, a long line of people passes more sandbags along; a man in a dark jacket brings the next one. She presses her bag into place. The river beside them has flooded the fields. Each of these volunteers is a patriot who protects the town in a flood out of love for the country.
